requirements.requirement: The system must execute unit tests validating correct parsing of valid last_update_date strings into date objects.
The system must execute unit tests verifying accurate calculation of days_since_update given a known current date and valid last_update_date.
The system must execute unit tests confirming normalized_recency_score outputs match defined scoring thresholds for recent, moderate, and stale updates.
The system must execute unit tests ensuring boundary conditions (e.g., exact threshold cutoffs) produce deterministic and expected normalized_recency_score values.
The system must execute unit tests verifying that missing last_update_date values trigger missing_data_flag = true and a default or null score.
The system must execute unit tests verifying that malformed date inputs are safely handled without runtime failure and result in missing_data_flag = true.
The system must execute integration tests confirming that clinical trial responses from the evaluation pipeline include normalized_recency_score for each trial when valid data is present.
The system must execute integration tests confirming that clinical trial responses include days_since_update and last_update_date fields alongside normalized_recency_score.
The system must execute integration tests verifying that trials with missing or invalid update data still return a response object with missing_data_flag = true.
The system must execute integration tests ensuring no regression or omission of other clinical trial fields when recency scoring is added to the response.
The system must ensure all recency scoring unit and integration tests pass in the existing backend test framework without requiring new test infrastructure.
The system must ensure test coverage includes at least one valid, one boundary, and two exception scenarios (missing and malformed dates) for recency scoring logic.
